complexityAnalysis.taskTitle: Complete data plane foundation with database and Redis connections
complexityAnalysis.expansionPrompt: Break down the AppState creation into: 1) Database connection pool setup with SQLx and PostgreSQL, 2) Redis client initialization with connection manager, 3) Configuration management and environment variable loading, 4) Shared data models (Route, Service, Plugin structs) that match the existing Go models, 5) Error handling and connection retry logic with graceful degradation
complexityAnalysis.reasoning: Medium-high complexity. The Cargo.toml shows all required dependencies (sqlx, redis, config) are already configured. Main.rs has placeholder code for AppState. Configuration structure exists but needs database/Redis integration. Requires careful connection pool management and error handling patterns.

complexityAnalysis.taskTitle: Implement route matching engine with trie-based algorithm
complexityAnalysis.expansionPrompt: Split into: 1) Design and implement trie data structure for route storage, 2) Implement exact path matching algorithm, 3) Add wildcard (*) pattern matching support, 4) Implement path parameter (:param) extraction, 5) Create Redis-backed route cache with fallback to PostgreSQL, 6) Add route priority handling and configuration sync mechanism
complexityAnalysis.reasoning: High complexity. Requires implementing a custom trie data structure from scratch for O(log n) performance. Must handle complex pattern matching (wildcards, parameters) and integrate with caching layer. No existing routing infrastructure found in current codebase.

complexityAnalysis.taskTitle: Develop HTTP proxy client with connection pooling
complexityAnalysis.expansionPrompt: Organize into: 1) Configure reqwest client with custom connection pooling settings, 2) Implement HTTP/1.1 and HTTP/2 protocol support with TLS, 3) Add configurable timeout handling (connect, read, write), 4) Implement request/response streaming for large payloads, 5) Create upstream health tracking with retry logic and exponential backoff
complexityAnalysis.reasoning: Medium-high complexity. Reqwest dependency is configured in Cargo.toml but no proxy implementation exists yet. Requires deep understanding of HTTP protocol details, connection management, and streaming. Health tracking adds additional complexity.

complexityAnalysis.taskTitle: Implement authentication middleware with JWT and API key validation
complexityAnalysis.expansionPrompt: Break into: 1) Implement JWT validation using jsonwebtoken crate with RS256/HS256 support, 2) Create API key authentication with Redis caching and database fallback, 3) Add multi-issuer JWT support and key rotation handling, 4) Implement user context extraction and workspace isolation middleware
complexityAnalysis.reasoning: Medium complexity. JWT dependencies (jsonwebtoken) already configured. Basic auth middleware structure exists in middleware/auth.rs but needs implementation. Workspace isolation pattern exists in Go models. Redis integration builds on Task 1.

complexityAnalysis.taskTitle: Build distributed rate limiting with token bucket algorithm
complexityAnalysis.expansionPrompt: Structure as: 1) Implement token bucket algorithm with configurable refill rates, 2) Create Redis-based distributed state management using sorted sets, 3) Add sliding window rate limiting as alternative algorithm, 4) Implement per-client, per-route, and global rate limiting scopes, 5) Add proper HTTP 429 responses with rate limit headers and Retry-After
complexityAnalysis.reasoning: Medium-high complexity. Governor crate is available but requires Redis integration for distributed behavior. Token bucket algorithm is complex to implement correctly. Must handle concurrent access across multiple data plane instances while maintaining accuracy.

complexityAnalysis.taskTitle: Create control plane API with database operations
complexityAnalysis.expansionPrompt: Divide into: 1) Implement database layer with SQLx for CRUD operations on routes, services, plugins, workspaces, 2) Create REST API handlers with input validation and error handling, 3) Add Redis pub/sub mechanism for configuration sync to data plane, 4) Implement workspace-based authorization and multi-tenancy validation
complexityAnalysis.reasoning: Medium complexity. Go dependencies (gin, pgx, redis) are configured and basic API structure exists with placeholder endpoints. Data models are well-defined in models/route.go. Mainly requires implementing database operations and validation logic.

complexityAnalysis.taskTitle: Implement load balancing and service health checking
complexityAnalysis.expansionPrompt: Organize as: 1) Extend Service model to support multiple upstream endpoints, 2) Implement round-robin load balancing algorithm, 3) Add least-connections and consistent hashing algorithms, 4) Create active health checking with periodic endpoint probes, 5) Implement circuit breaker pattern using failsafe crate, 6) Add service discovery integration hooks and configuration management
complexityAnalysis.reasoning: High complexity. Requires significant changes to existing Service model and proxy logic. Multiple load balancing algorithms are complex to implement correctly. Health checking requires background tasks and state management. Circuit breaker pattern adds additional complexity.

complexityAnalysis.taskTitle: Build plugin system foundation with execution engine
complexityAnalysis.expansionPrompt: Break down into: 1) Design and implement Plugin trait with request/response transformation methods, 2) Create PluginExecutor for priority-ordered execution with error isolation, 3) Implement plugin registry for loading and configuration at startup, 4) Develop built-in plugins (header transformation, logging, CORS), 5) Add plugin configuration support at global, service, and route levels
complexityAnalysis.reasoning: Medium-high complexity. Basic plugins module structure exists but no implementation. Requires designing a flexible trait system and execution engine. Error isolation is critical for system stability. Plugin configuration hierarchy adds complexity.

complexityAnalysis.taskTitle: Integrate observability with Prometheus metrics and OpenTelemetry tracing
complexityAnalysis.expansionPrompt: Structure into: 1) Implement Prometheus metrics collection for request count, latency histograms, and error rates, 2) Add OpenTelemetry tracing with span creation for requests, database queries, and Redis operations, 3) Create structured logging with trace correlation IDs, 4) Configure OTLP export to Jaeger and custom metrics for plugin execution times
complexityAnalysis.reasoning: Medium complexity. All observability dependencies are configured (prometheus, opentelemetry, tracing). Basic metrics structure exists. Requires integration across all components but follows well-established patterns. Trace correlation adds some complexity.

complexityAnalysis.taskTitle: Complete React portal with route management and analytics dashboard
complexityAnalysis.expansionPrompt: Organize into: 1) Implement route management UI with form validation using react-hook-form and Zod, 2) Create service configuration interface with health status indicators, 3) Build analytics dashboard with Recharts for metrics visualization, 4) Add real-time updates using TanStack Query with polling, 5) Implement workspace switching UI and plugin configuration wizard with JSON schema forms
complexityAnalysis.reasoning: Medium complexity. All React dependencies are configured (react-hook-form, Zod, Recharts, TanStack Query). Basic page structure exists with placeholder components. Portal already has API client setup. Mainly requires UI implementation and API integration.
